item.title: Reader: a picture inside a link opens the linked image or asks before leaving (#912)
item.body:
Closes #912
Claim: mac/mac-mbp
Author model: Sonnet 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-w912)
Reviewer model: Opus 5.5 (mac/mac-mbp-r1279e-opus)

**Problem.** `reader.js` posted only the picture's own `src` on a tap and ignored the `<a href>` around it: a thumbnail linking to its full-size image opened the thumbnail, one linking to a page opened the picture and never the page, and nothing warned before leaving.

**Cause.** LOT-109's tap message had no field for the wrapping link, so the app could not decide anything about it.

**Change.**
- `reader.js` sends `link` (the resolved `href` of `picture.closest("a[href]")`, null outside a link) with the existing `image` message; the page never navigates. `ReaderBridgeMessage.image(urls:index:link:)` reads it strictly (absent or null is unlinked; another type rejects the message; longer than `maximumLinkLength` is dropped, the tap then opens today's viewer).
- `ReaderPictureTap.decide` (new): http(s) link that is an image and that policy C lets the viewer fetch -> `.linkedImage` (viewer opens it through `ImageGallery.build(linked:)`; the table's full size of the picture, then the preview, stay the fallbacks); other link -> `.link`; no usable link -> `.viewer`.
  - "Is an image": on a host with an `ImageHostTable` rule that serves extension-less images, the path must have the shape of the rule's image (`img3.super-h.fr/images/`, `rehost.diberie.com/Picture/Get/f/`), whatever its extension; elsewhere, an image extension read from the path. `reho.st` has no captured image shape, so its links are page links (capture issue #1280), except that a `reho.st/thumb/…` picture with a same-host link takes the `.viewer` exception (no corpus case).
  - The host's own viewer page of a thumbnail the table can enlarge (img3 `/image/<id>` around `…th.png`) is today's `.viewer`, on the full size: no regression from dev-swift and no warning.
  - Consent is per address: a third-party linked image is fetched only when its own address is consented or "load third-party images" is on, or it is the picture's own full size (which the viewer fetches anyway). Otherwise (even on the picture's own host) it is a `.link`: it gets the « page externe » warning, and Ouvrir loads it in the browser, not in the viewer (no silent third-party fetch).
- `ReaderPictureLinkPrompt` (new): « Ce lien ouvre une page externe » + the domain, **Ouvrir** / **Annuler**; Ouvrir follows « Navigateur par défaut ». A forum link takes the LOT-137 route with no warning.
- One implementation of the full-size rule: the viewer still goes through `ImageGallery.fullSize(of:)` / `ImageHostTable.fullSizeURL` (#917 unaffected).
- CSP and the no-page-script guarantees are untouched; the link only decides which URL the app-side gallery fetches (policy C, cookie-less client) or routes through `ReaderLinkAction`, never the session client.
- `TopicReaderView.swift` stays at 399 lines (the linked-reader binding moved to `LinkedReader.binding(of:)`, the link switch became `open(_:asking:)`).

**Tests** (iPhone 17 clone, iOS 27.2, unsigned).
- `ReaderPictureLinkTests` (10 tests) and `ImageViewerModelTests`. Round 1 adds: `anImg3ThumbnailLinkedToItsViewerPageStaysTheViewerOnTheFullSize` (R298a/b/e pair, anonymized as in the corpus), `aRehostViewLinkIsAPageUntilItsCaptureSaysOtherwise` (R122c), the per-address consent assertions of `anImageOnAnotherThirdPartyHostIsNotFetchedWithoutTheSetting`, `aLinkLongerThanTheBridgeKeepsOpensTodaysViewer` (routing of a link over 2048 bytes: today's viewer, no page asked), and `aLinkedAddressThatIsNoImageFallsBackToTheTablesFullSizeBeforeTheThumbnail`.
- Red on a795f933 (sources of that head, the new tests without the `consented:` argument that does not exist there): 4 of the 22 tests in the two suites fail (8 issues): the img3 pair, the reho.st view link, the same-host consent, the fallback order. The 2048-byte test passes there: it records existing behaviour.
- Green on 8ddefdac: 76 tests in 10 suites passed in 20.8 s (ReaderPictureLinkTests, ImageGalleryTests, ReaderImageViewerBridgeTests, ReaderBridgeMessageTests, ReaderBridgeWiringTests, ReaderWebSecurityTests, ReaderWebControllerTests, ReaderImageBaselineWebTests, ReaderComposerSuspensionTests, ImageViewerModelTests).
- SwiftLint counted by hand (lines <= 140, files <= 400, no `Bool?`); `TopicReaderView.swift` stays at 399.

**Corpus check** (`Packages/HFRKit/Tests/HFRParsingTests/Fixtures/captures/`, links around pictures):
- Image extension on a host without a rule (rule b): a link whose path ends in an image extension, the picture itself being that file (R28 `i.imgur.com/dmD8vSul.png` linked to `i.imgur.com/dmD8vSu.png`, also `BmnE6n1h`; R298c/d `img3.super-h.fr/images/…` links equal to the picture).
- `img3.super-h.fr` shape: `/images/…` is an image (link equals the picture, `R298c/d`); `/image/<id>` is Chevereto's viewer page around a `/images/<hash>.th.png` thumbnail (`R298a`, `R298b`, `R298e`: 6 distinct ids, e.g. `gd99`, `gog4`). Not an image.
- `rehost.diberie.com`: `/Picture/Get/f/<id>` linked around `/Picture/Get/r/<id>` (one capture); `f` is the table's rewrite target.
- `reho.st`: `/view/self/<hash>.png|jpg` around `/preview/` and `/medium/` thumbnails (`R122c`, 4 links). No capture shows what `/view/` or `/self/<hash>` serves: page links until #1280 (a `reho.st/thumb/…` picture with a same-host link takes the `.viewer` exception).

**Legacy check** (`87fe0d1c`). Legacy does neither of the two in general:
- `MessagesView.swift:1150-1235`: the tap script reads the picture's `longdesc` attribute (not the wrapping `<a>`), and only for a small (<= 200 px) `img3.super-h.fr` thumbnail whose linked image has the same identity (`.th.` stripped) and an image extension (`Common.swift:2243-2256` `isImageURL`); then it opens the viewer on the linked URL. Parity: a link to an image opens that image.
- Every other tap falls through to the link's own navigation; a search of `87fe0d1c` for a warning string (`page externe`, `lien externe`) finds none. So the warning, and following a wrapping link to any image (not only small img3 thumbnails), are deliberate differences.
- Rule (b) (generic image extension) cites legacy's `imageExtensions` list (`Common.swift:2231-2242`). The corpus check above replaces the first version's claim that none was done.

### Ledger

```changelog
| UX | Une image placée dans un lien ouvre l'image liée en grand dans la visionneuse quand le lien mène à une image, et demande confirmation (« Ce lien ouvre une page externe », avec le domaine) avant d'ouvrir toute autre page ; un lien du forum s'ouvre dans l'app sans avertissement. | #1279 | `MessagesView.swift:1150-1235`, `Common.swift:2243-2256` @ `87fe0d1c` |
```

```gap-new
Section: Reader
| GAP-912 | Image dans un lien | Un clic ouvre la visionneuse sur le lien seulement pour une miniature img3.super-h.fr de 200 px ou moins (attribut `longdesc`) ; sinon le lien est suivi sans avertissement | `MessagesView.swift:1150-1235`; `Common.swift:2243-2256` @ `87fe0d1c` | Un lien vers une image s'ouvre dans la visionneuse (repli sur la taille réelle de la table, puis l'aperçu) ; tout autre lien demande confirmation avec le domaine ; lien du forum sans avertissement ; une image tierce non autorisée (son adresse n'a pas été acceptée et le réglage est coupé) est traitée comme une page : avertissement « page externe », Ouvrir la charge dans le navigateur ; la page de visualisation img3 d'une miniature garde la visionneuse sur la taille réelle ; liens reho.st = pages sauf une miniature `reho.st/thumb/…` avec un lien du même hôte, qui garde la visionneuse (capture #1280) | #912 | UX change | operator (#912) | b |
```

comments.body: **Adversarial review (Opus 5.5, mac/mac-mbp-r1279-opus, head a795f933)**: REQUEST CHANGES Agent: mac/mac-mbp-r1279-opus (Opus 5.5) 1. **High: the captured img3 thumbnail shape regresses from full size to the thumbnail.** `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Viewer/ReaderPictureTap.swift:37-38` (`isImage`), `ImageGallery.swift:59-63`. Real posts wrap an img3 thumbnail in a link to the Chevereto **viewer page**: `` (captures `R298a`, `R298b`, `R298e`, 18 hits of `img3.super-h.fr/image/` in the corpus). `servesExtensionlessImages(img3)` plus a path longer than `/` makes `/image/gd99` an "image". `linkedFull` leaves it unchanged (it is not under `/images/`), and it is on the same host, so it becomes `.linkedImage` and replaces `full`. The viewer then fetches an HTML page, fails, and falls back to `shown` (`ImageViewerModel.swift:185-188`): the `.th.` thumbnail. On dev-swift, `full` was `fullSizeURL(shown)`, the full image. This breaks acceptance criterion 1 and #917, and "Copier le lien" / Photos now get the thumbnail. Legacy never took such a link: it needed `/images/` and an identity match (`MessagesView.swift:1150-1235`, `Common.swift:2259-2290` @ 87fe0d1c). Fix: count an extensionless-host link as an image only when its path matches the rule's image shape (for example the rewrite's `pathPrefix`). Keep `fullSize(of: shown)` as a fallback before `shown`. Add a test with this captured pair. 2. **Medium: the issue's corpus check was skipped.** The issue asks to check rule (b) against the corpus, and to cite a capture or open a capture issue. The PR says no capture was checked, and no issue was opened. A check would have found finding 1. Separately, `reho.st/view/self/.png` around a `/preview/` thumbnail (16 hits) now gets fetched, but nothing shows that `/view/` serves an image. Cite the capture, or open the capture issue. 3. **Low: consent is per picture, not per host.** `ImageGallery.swift:73-85` (doc and `sameHost`). `consented` holds image addresses (`ReaderWebController.swift:268`), so "consent covers the picture's own host" is wrong. A consented third-party thumbnail lets an unconsented address on that host be fetched. It is a small leak, because that host already has the IP. Either reword the doc and accept this on the record, or require `autoLoadsThirdParty`. 4. **Low (author's choice: acceptable)**: a third-party linked image that the user has not allowed gets the "page externe" warning, and Ouvrir loads it in a full browser. That is better for privacy than a silent fetch. But the sentence is inaccurate, and the GAP-912 row does not mention the case. Add it to the GAP row, or open the viewer on the preview. 5. **Detail**: `ReaderBridgeMessage.swift:154`: a link over 2,048 bytes is dropped, so a page link silently opens the viewer instead of asking. This is safe, but untested for the routing. Security: no finding. Only http(s) links are kept. `ImagePolicy` blocks userinfo, numeric/private hosts and forum non-image paths. Page links go through the existing `action(forLink:)` / LOT-137 route. The dialog shows `host()`, which is punycode from WebKit's `href`. The CSP and the page script are untouched. Bridge decoding is strict. Verified (static only): read the diff, the issue, and the PR body. `ledger.py check-body`: 2 blocks ok. Legacy citations are accurate at 87fe0d1c. Checked line widths and file lengths by hand (TopicReaderView 399, Swift lines ≤ 140). The refactor (`LinkedReader.binding`, `open(_:asking:)`) changes no behaviour. Grepped the corpus for link shapes around thumbnails. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code)_

**mac/mac-mbp** (Sonnet 5.5, mac/mac-mbp-w912b): review round 1 fixed in 8ddefdac. Agent: mac/mac-mbp-w912b.

1. **High** — fixed in 8ddefdac. On a host with an extension-less rule, a link is an image only under the rule's image path (`img3.super-h.fr/images/`, `rehost.diberie.com/Picture/Get/f/`). The img3 viewer-page link (`/image/<id>`, R298a/b/e) around an enlargeable thumbnail is today's viewer on the table's full size. The viewer falls back to the table's full size before the thumbnail. `reho.st/view/self/<hash>.png` (R122c) is a page link: nothing proves `/view/` serves an image. Tests `anImg3ThumbnailLinkedToItsViewerPageStaysTheViewerOnTheFullSize` and `aRehostViewLinkIsAPageUntilItsCaptureSaysOtherwise`, `aLinkedAddressThatIsNoImageFallsBackToTheTablesFullSizeBeforeTheThumbnail`: red on a795f933, green on 8ddefdac.
2. **Medium** — done. The corpus check with captures per rule is in the PR body ("Corpus check"). The shape without a capture (`reho.st`) is a page link, and the capture issue is #1280.
3. **Low** — fixed in 8ddefdac, strict option: a third-party linked image is fetched only when its own address is consented or third-party auto-load is on; otherwise it takes the page-link route. One exception, stated in the doc comment and tested: the picture's own table full size, which the viewer already fetches for the consented picture.
4. **Low** — PR body and GAP-912 row now say that a non-allowed third-party linked image gets the « page externe » warning and that Ouvrir loads it in the browser. `ledger.py check-body`: 2 blocks ok.
5. **Detail** — `aLinkLongerThanTheBridgeKeepsOpensTodaysViewer` added (a link over 2048 bytes opens today's viewer, no page asked). It passes on a795f933 too: it records existing behaviour.

Tests on an iPhone 17 clone, iOS 27.2: red on a795f933, 4 of the 22 tests of the two suites fail (8 issues); green on 8ddefdac, 76 tests in 10 suites (reader, gallery, viewer, bridge, security) passed.

The viewer falls back to the table's full size before the thumbnail. Consent is now per address.

**Choice (a): accepted.** `ReaderPictureTap.swift:30-34`. Legacy never followed `/image/<id>`: `isImageURL` needs an extension, so legacy let WebKit navigate (`MessagesView.swift:1150-1235` @ 87fe0d1c). Read literally, issue #912 would show a warning here. But the issue's intent is that the full image opens. The exception gives exactly that, with dev-swift's behaviour and no external fetch. It is recorded in GAP-912.

**Choice (b): verified.** `own` is `candidate == fullSize(of: shown)`, exactly the `full` that dev-swift's `build` fetches for the consented picture (`ImageGallery.swift:59` on dev-swift). The new fallback, `ImageViewerModel.swift:187`, fetches the same address. Neither fetches more than dev-swift. The default setting is `ImageAutoLoad.always`, so the stricter consent only affects users in tap-to-load or Wi-Fi-only mode.

1. **Low: the corpus check miscites its sources and misses the one rule-(b) capture.** `ReaderPictureTap.swift:45,56`, `ReaderPictureLinkTests.swift:27`, PR body "Corpus check".

2. **Detail: three statements say all `reho.st` links are pages, which is not quite true.** PR body, GAP-912 row and #1280 all say so. A `reho.st/thumb/…` picture with any same-host link takes the `.viewer` exception (`:32`). There is no corpus case. Reword these statements, or exclude that host.
3. **Detail: a weak assertion.** `ReaderPictureLinkTests.swift:33-34`: `!=` would also pass for `.viewer`. Assert `== .link(…)` instead.
